description: Ministry of Energy - Revise the fuel Price to be Effective from 12.00 Midnight on September 30th, 2024.
reasoning: This gazette contains a legal/regulatory order issued under Section 66 of the Ceylon Petroleum Corporation Act, No. 28 of 1961, revising fuel prices.
